description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling Java and C++ code, including string manipulation, file path generation, and parsing C++ constants, primarily used for code generation or translation tasks within a build system.

classes.name: JavaString
classes.description: Represents a Java string constant with formatting capabilities.

classes.name: CppConstantParser
classes.description: Parses C++ constants from source lines, retaining comments, with an inner Delegate class for custom extraction.

methods.name: GetJavaFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a Java file path from package and class name.

methods.name: KCamelToShouty
methods.description: Converts CamelCase or kCamelCase strings to SHOUTY_CASE.

methods.name: ParseTemplateFile
methods.description: Parses package and class name from a list of lines.
